dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric, rapid narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor inward curvature at the nuchal region posterior to the blowhole; lateral margins are otherwise smooth and continuous.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Consistent slate-grey pigmentation across the dorsal surface, significantly darker than mature white phenotypes.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey patches visible across the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradual, diffuse transitions between varying shades of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple parallel longitudinal linear marks (rake marks) visible as high-contrast white lines on the posterior dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent circular depression at the blowhole site; no other unnatural topological deformations observed.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible longitudinal linear scarring or rake marks concentrated on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
